data.translation: But whichever book came into my hand, which I did not read once and twice, until I had gained what was in it, brought something out of it, I would not let it go.

rationale: New I Infectum-wa box, provisionally; acquisition of book contents with inherited ʕal-government.

data.translation: Ich, Alyäs Maskobi, möchte eine kurdische Geschichte erzählen, eine wahre Begebenheit (!), die sich vor Zeiten zugetragen hat.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (75/349)

data.turoyo: Annaqla u abro du qaḍi, du mufti kəmmi: “Xulo b mede xayifo amṭelan? Mayiṯina w i ruḥayḏan nafiqo hul d qadirina ḥəṣlina aʕle.”
data.translation: Der Sohn des Kadi und der Mufti sagten: "Haben wir sie etwa leichten Kaufes bekommen und hergebracht? Wir sind fast gestorben und umgekommen, bis wir ihrer habhaft wurden!"

rationale: Second Infectum2 example: dependent acquisition form and ʕal-object, with ability construction in context.

data.turoyo: Ḥzay haqqayəs məštaq wayye li mamlakaṯṯe, lu aṯraṯṯe, li dukṯaṯṯe. W Aloho maḥṣəlelənyo l goran dan niyat dəṯṯe.
data.translation: See how much they longed for their homeland, their country, their place. And God obtained it for them in accordance with their intentions.

rationale: New provisional III stem and sense 1; l-recipient plus resumed supplied theme.

data.translation: Khori Brahim: Honestly, after the Sayfo, they went, they to Adana, they went and ended up there.

data.translation: To build ourselves 'a national library', that is, in whatever language there is something written about these people, books that we obtain, we shall put them inside that library.

rationale: Thin I Infectum sense 2 after two retained examples; books as the overt context for aʕle.
